..$comment: NO extra-files, and that is the one deliberate divergence from Koine / blazor-tailwind-ui / AdrMcp / x402-dotnet, which all write the version into Directory.Build.props. FormCraft gets its version from MinVer, which reads the git tag release-please creates — so the tag is already the single source of truth and a written <Version> element would be inert: build/Build.cs records that MinVer's targets override any version passed in. Adding one would also turn Directory.Build.props into a new merge hot-spot for no gain. include-component-in-tag MUST stay false: Directory.Build.props sets <MinVerTagPrefix>v</MinVerTagPrefix>, so a component tag (formcraft-v3.2.0) would match no prefix, MinVer would find no tag, and both packages would pack and publish as 0.0.0-alpha.0.N to nuget.org — which delists but never deletes. JSON carries no comments; this key is inert, and the config schema allows extra keys inside a package entry.
